name: edgies-veggies
description: Marketing site for a small-scale market garden in St. Paul, MN.

scripts.copy-assets: cp node_modules/uikit/dist/js/uikit-core.min.js assets/js/ && cp node_modules/uikit/dist/js/components/slideshow.min.js assets/js/uikit-slideshow.min.js && cp node_modules/uikit/dist/js/uikit-icons.min.js assets/js/
scripts.build: npm run copy-assets && bundle exec jekyll build && npm run purgecss
scripts.start: npm run build && bundle exec jekyll serve --skip-initial-build
